question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Presumably
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Presumably"** means something that is assumed or believed to be true based on the available information. (अनुमानतः)

 
 
• **Example:** **Presumably**, she will be attending the meeting as she confirmed her presence earlier.
 
 
 
• **"Unlikely"** refers to something that is not probable or expected to happen. (असंभावित)
 
 
• **Example:** It is **unlikely **that they will finish the project ahead of schedule given the current pace.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Presumably'** is **'Unlikely'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Certainly** (निश्चित रूप से): Something that is sure or without any doubt.

 
 
• **Example:** She will **certainly **help you with your homework if you ask her.
 
 
 
• **Liberally** (उदारतापूर्वक): In a generous or free manner.
 
 
• **Example:** He **liberally **donated to various charities.
 
 
 
• **Successfully** (सफलतापूर्वक): In a way that accomplishes a desired aim or result.
 
 
• **Example:** The team **successfully **completed the project before the deadline.
